name: Countermark
description: Two marks side by side, one the negative of the other.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; width: 38%; top: 26%; height: 38%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 30%, #000 30% 50%, transparent 50%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 30%, #000 30% 50%, transparent 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 54%; width: 38%; top: 36%; height: 38%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 30%, transparent 30%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 30%, transparent 30%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
